assessment: The source supports a matched pair of normalized Lyapunov scaling laws over the DNS Reynolds-number range Re in [50,1400]. The DNS exponent alpha=0.59 is explicitly reported with uncertainty, and the Kolmogorov mean-field prediction lambda ~ sqrt(Re) (alpha=0.5) is explicitly presented as a competing law on the same normalized domain. Both branches are encoded as (Re/50)^alpha using anchored parameters. The source does not report an amplitude for either law, so the normalized form is used without an unreported prefactor. The source supports the DNS range and the two exponents, so case_authoring_ready is true.

paper_scope: The paper studies the Reynolds-number dependence of the largest Lyapunov exponent in fully developed turbulence using decorrelators, DNS of the Navier-Stokes equation, and the GOY shell model. It reports a universal scaling lambda ~ Re^alpha with alpha=0.59±0.04, departing from the Kolmogorov mean-field prediction lambda ~ sqrt(Re). The selected cluster focuses on the DNS-based normalized Lyapunov scaling over Re in [50,1400].
